description: Tray monitor for AI coding-agent token usage, cost, and subscription quota. Windows port of TokenBar.
notes: Syrtis is managed by Scoop here, not by its own installer. Update it with
In 0.3.0 the in-app 'Check for updates' button reports a failure on a Scoop
install. Nothing is wrong and nothing is broken: that build has no way to
tell 'someone else manages this copy' apart from 'the check failed'. A later
release says so plainly instead. Either way, the button is not the update
Usage data lives in %APPDATA%\tokscale and %LOCALAPPDATA%\TokenBar, outside
the Scoop directory, so it survives updates and is left behind on uninstall.
pre_uninstall: # Launch at login writes HKCU\...\Run\Syrtis pointing at the running exe.
# Only the Velopack uninstaller clears it (OnBeforeUninstallFastCallback), and
# an extraction install never runs that, so without this the Run entry would
# survive pointing into a directory Scoop is about to delete.
# Conditional on the value living under this app's Scoop directory: the same
# machine may also hold a Velopack install that legitimately owns this value,
# and deleting that one would silently break its launch at login.
# scoop update runs this hook too - scoop-update.ps1 calls Invoke-HookScript
# 'pre_uninstall' with the old manifest before installing the replacement -
# and the hook is given no argument that distinguishes an update from a
# removal. So the value is recorded before deletion and post_install puts it
# back. On a real uninstall post_install never runs and it stays gone.
try {
$appRoot = Split-Path $dir -Parent
$run = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
$current = (Get-ItemProperty -Path $run -Name 'Syrtis' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).'Syrtis'
if ($current -and $current.Trim('"').StartsWith($appRoot, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {
Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'syrtis-autostart.restore') -Value $current -Encoding UTF8
Remove-ItemProperty -Path $run -Name 'Syrtis' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$approved = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\StartupApproved\Run'
Remove-ItemProperty -Path $approved -Name 'Syrtis' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
} catch { }
post_install: # Restores the launch-at-login entry pre_uninstall removed during an update.
# Nothing to do on a first install: the marker only exists if this app's own
# The age check is what keeps a final uninstall final. Without it, a marker
# left by a real removal would sit in TEMP and silently re-enable launch at
# login on an unrelated install weeks later. Scoop's update runs uninstall and
# install back to back, so anything older than a few minutes is not an update.
Write-Host 'Restored launch at login across the update.'
